RVR Horse Rescue is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization located in Plant City, Florida.

Mission Statement: RVR Horse Rescue harnesses the power of volunteers to rescue, rehabilitate, and re-home horses that have suffered abuse, neglect, or injury.
